crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.body: This screen hit an error it could not recover from. Your data is safe on this device.
crash.guest: Error reports need an account, so nothing was sent.
crash.whatIsSent: A report says which error happened and where in our code. It never includes what you entered.

policy.body: It now covers error reports, which stay off unless you switch them on, and the Android check for updates on F-Droid.

app.name: LimeLog
app.tagline: Track your lifts. Beat your records.

common.storageFull: Storage is full, so this change could not be saved. Free up space (e.g. delete some progress photos) and try again.

auth.subGetStarted: Sign in to sync workouts to Nexus, or continue locally.
auth.nexusNote: SIGNED IN TO NEXUS COMMAND CENTER ON THIS DEVICE
auth.guestNote: Local only — workouts stay on this device. You can sign in later from Profile → Settings.
auth.notConfigured: Supabase not configured — sign-in unavailable. Tap Continue as guest to use the app locally.
auth.errAlreadyRegistered: That email already has an account. Try signing in instead.
auth.errEmailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first — check your inbox for the link.
auth.errRateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
auth.errNetwork: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
auth.ageNote: You must be 16+ to create an account (13+ where local law allows). Under that age, use guest mode — nothing leaves your device.
auth.otpHint: The code is valid for 60 minutes. The link in the email still works too.
auth.errOtp: That code did not work. Check it and try again.
auth.errOtpResend: Could not send a new code. Try again shortly.
auth.errOtpLength: That code looks incomplete. Copy the whole code from the email.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Track your lifts, watch your numbers climb, and beat your records — one session at a time.
onboarding.goalBody: This frames your progress. You can shift focus anytime — it doesn't lock anything.
onboarding.howBody: Every workout is built the same way:
onboarding.howStep1: Pick the exercises in your session
onboarding.howStep2: Log each set as you go
onboarding.howStep3: Record the reps and weight you hit
onboarding.languageBody: You can change this anytime in Settings.

progress.title: Progress
progress.noLoadBody: Complete a session to see load trends.
progress.noOrmBody: Complete a session with weight × reps logged to see an estimated 1RM trend.
progress.noHistoryBody: Finish a session to see it here.
progress.needTwo: Log at least 2 sessions to see a trend.
progress.weightUpBody: You hit the top of the rep range on every set for the exercises below. Confirm form was solid to apply the weight increase.
progress.noJumpsBody: Track your vertical jump to monitor athletic progress.

today.noProgramBody: Create a program in the Program tab to get started.
today.restBody: No sessions scheduled today. Recovery is training.
today.stallAlert_one: {{count}} stall flag detected — consider a deload
today.stallAlert_other: {{count}} stall flags detected — consider a deload
today.deloadAdvance: {{missed}}/{{total}} sets fell short over your last 3 sessions — consider advancing to a deload phase.
today.deloadSchedule: {{missed}}/{{total}} sets fell short over your last 3 sessions — consider scheduling a deload.

settings.errorReportsNote: When the app hits an error it cannot recover from, it sends us which error it was, where in our code, the app and Android or browser version, and the screen that was open. Never what you entered. Kept 90 days.
settings.aiFeaturesOnSub: AI debrief on — the note you type after a workout is sent to Google Gemini.
settings.aiFeaturesOffSub: AI debrief off — nothing is sent to Google. Rate fatigue with the dots above.
settings.aiTrainingNote: Google runs this on their free tier, which means what you send may be used to train their future models. Leave it off if that is not for you.
settings.yourDataNote: Take a copy of everything, or erase it. One account covers LimeLog, Nexus Command Center and StudyDesk.
settings.deleteAccountNote: Erases your account and all its data, in all three apps, immediately and irreversibly. There is no recovery window.
settings.deleteAccountConfirm1: Delete your account and everything in it? This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteAccountConfirm2: Last check — this also erases your Nexus Command Center and StudyDesk data. Continue?
settings.supportDevSub: A link to Ko-fi. Supporters get the Cast Iron theme; nothing else in the app is locked behind it.
settings.discordSub: Questions, bug reports, and what's coming next
settings.themeSupporterNote: Cast Iron is a supporter theme. Every workout feature stays free — this is a palette, not a paywall.
settings.fdroidCheckNote: Once a day, LimeLog asks f-droid.org for its newest version. Nothing about you is sent. Turning this off stops the request entirely.

sync.title: Nexus sync
sync.changeEmailWhy: This changes the email you sign in with, in StudyDesk, NCC and LimeLog. We send a link to your current address and one to the new address, and the change takes effect once you have opened both.
sync.changeEmailPending: Waiting for confirmation: {{next}}. Open the links sent to {{current}} and to {{next}}. Until then, sign in with {{current}}.
sync.changeEmailTaken: Another account already uses that address.
sync.changeEmailRateLimit: Too many emails were sent just now. Try again later.
sync.changeEmailFailed: Couldn't send the links. Check your connection and try again.
sync.changeEmailInvalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
sync.changeEmailGoogle: You sign in with Google, so your email is your Google address.
sync.signOutConfirm: Sign out? Your workouts, body measurements and progress photos will be removed from this device.
sync.signOutUnsynced_one: {{count}} change has not reached your account yet and will be lost.
sync.signOutUnsynced_other: {{count}} changes have not reached your account yet and will be lost.
sync.signOutSyncOff: Sync is off, so your workouts on this device have not been saved to your account: they will be lost.
sync.signOutPhotos_one: {{count}} progress photo is kept only on this device and will be deleted.
sync.signOutPhotos_other: {{count}} progress photos are kept only on this device and will be deleted.
sync.stuck_one: {{count}} item stuck after retries — check connection or sign back in.
sync.stuck_other: {{count}} items stuck after retries — check connection or sign back in.
